That's exactly what I needed to see. Your two linked pictures still didn't open for me, but the live app itself now tells the whole story: NASA is sitting at the top of the library with its title and a real description pulled in automatically, tagged and marked "Just now," and the count has moved to seven and held there. Between this and the earlier library view — searching, favorites, collections, archive, sorting, grid/list — the app does what I set out to build: I can save links and comfortably manage and revisit them. I'm happy with it.
